subject: Exhibit sightlines & crate-run plan — approvals needed
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kara Booker <kara@expoworks.com>, Moscone Operations <expoops@moscone.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exhibit sightlines & crate-run plan — approvals needed

Hi Kara / ExpoOps team,

We received the updated floor plan (attached) for Redwood’s pod (7C) at Moscone West. A couple of quick asks before we lock signage and crate routing:  

1) Sightlines: there’s a concrete pillar just east of our location that the account team flagged as likely to block the primary demo sightline from Aisle 3. Can you confirm the precise pillar offset and whether the standard 6ft banner stand will be fully visible from the main aisle? If not, we need alternative placement options.

2) Crate-run window: our vendor (LogisticsPlus) is planning a morning crate run on move-in day. Moscone’s freight window is tight (8–10am). Can you confirm whether a dedicated service-corridor slot is available for a 2-crate pallet (dimensions in the manifest) and whether a hand-truck escort is required?

3) Signage grommets & power: signage_specs.jpg lists two grommet locations; please confirm if the backwall bracket points are masked by the pillar. Also confirm nearby power bollard coordinates so we can finalize cable grommet count.

Attachments: floorplan_v2.pdf (layout), crate_manifest.xlsx (crates + weights), signage_specs.jpg

Goal: approvals on visibility & crate-run by EOD Monday so procurement can place final print + crate labels.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Kara Booker <kara@expoworks.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Moscone Operations <expoops@moscone.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@logisticsplus.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exhibit sightlines & crate-run plan — approvals needed

Hi Rishi — thanks for the clear notes and files. Quick responses inline:  

- Pillar offset: The pillar you're referencing is 2.1ft from our east boundary line (see annotation on floorplan_v2.pdf). That will partially obscure a 6ft banner placed flush to the backwall if centered; recommended fix is to shift the banner 18–24 inches west and angle it 10 degrees toward Aisle 3. I added an overlay to floorplan_v2.pdf labelled "sightline-annot".

- Crate-run: Moscone has confirmed a 8:30–9:30am dedicated dock slot for Redwood on move-in day. A hand-truck escort is not mandatory but recommended due to a 90-degree corridor turn. Dimensions look fine for a 2-crate pallet; please ensure crates are shrink-wrapped and have the attached crate_manifest.xlsx label applied to both sides.

- Signage & power: The nearest power bollard is located 7ft from the rear-right corner (grid coord D4). Grommet locations in signage_specs.jpg are good, but you’ll need one extra cable grommet for the east-facing demo kiosk due to the pillar-run.

I attached a high-res markup (floorplan_v2_sightlines.pdf) and updated crate instructions. Let me know if you want me to request a temporary cone to protect the sightline during opening hours.

Best,
Kara Booker
Senior Event Ops Manager | ExpoWorks Logistics
[Attachment: floorplan_v2_sightlines.pdf (PDF, 0.8MB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exhibit sightlines & crate-run plan — approvals needed

Thanks Kara — good catch on the pillar. A couple internal points:  

- APPROVE banner shift (18in west + 10deg angle). Procurement: please order one extra grommet kit and an angled banner stand (SKU: BSTR-ANG-24).

- Collateral counts: crate_manifest.xlsx shows 3 crates total but one crate is a restock crate that we can stage at Show HQ. Diego, can you confirm which crate contains the extra 200 one-sheets? If it’s crate C3 we’ll hold it at HQ and reduce the on-floor count to 2.

- Cones & sightline: I’m in favor of temporary cones for opening hours. Logistics cost is minimal and will pay off in demo flow. Kara — please include a cone request in the service order if available.

Marissa Cole
Director, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: procurement_PO_7321.pdf — sent to procurement@redwoodinference.com]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kara Booker <kara@expoworks.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@logisticsplus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 17:34:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Exhibit sightlines & crate-run plan — approvals needed

All — final confirmation and next steps:  

1) Sightlines: Approved. Kara, proceed with the adjusted banner placement you annotated. Please confirm final on-floor coordinates by Thursday so print shop can center artwork.

2) Crate-run: Liam / LogisticsPlus — crate run confirmed for 8:30–9:30am move-in. Please ensure pallet 2 is shrink-wrapped and labeled with the crate_manifest.xlsx IDs. If crate C3 is held at Show HQ, note that in the gate manifest.

3) Signage & power: Procurement will order an extra grommet kit and an angled banner stand (Marissa has approved). Tessa — please add the extra cable grommet to the power order and confirm ETA.

4) Cones: Kara, include 6 low-profile cones for opening hours in the service order and add a line-item estimate to the Expoworks request link: https://app.expoworks.com/requests/RED-4281.

I’m attaching the latest pack for the team (floorplan_v2.pdf, signage_specs.jpg, crate_manifest.xlsx). If there are no objections, I’ll mark the thread APPROVED and finalize the doc with procurement by EOD Thursday.

Thanks everyone — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: floorplan_v2.pdf, signage_specs.jpg, crate_manifest.xlsx]
